preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 10**9 for x in xs)
preconditions.description: Each target value x_i is an integer between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of provided target values matches t.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1') or (len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].isdigit() and parts[1].isdigit() and 1 <= int(parts[1]) <= int(parts[0]) <= 10**9) for line, parts in zip(output_lines, [line.split() for line in output_lines]))
postconditions.description: Each output line is either '-1' or two positive integers n and m where 1 <= m <= n <= 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i].strip() == '-1' and not exists_valid_pair(xs[i])) or (output_lines[i].strip() != '-1' and max_ones(int(output_lines[i].split()[0]), int(output_lines[i].split()[1])) == xs[i]) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, if the output is '-1', no valid pair (n, m) exists that yields x_i ones; otherwise, the output pair (n, m) yields exactly x_i ones as the maximum number of 1s in an m-free n x n matrix.
